name: Witch Smeller
crime: Impersonating an Officer of the Inquisition & Unlicensed Witch Smelling
biography: Armed with a heavy pistol & extensive training to sniff out the distinctive sulphurous scents of witchcraft, the Witch Smeller once practiced her trade in the villages & hamlets of the Lowlands. There, she rounded up witches & mutants at rates competitive with those of the Smellers of the Inquisition.

A good business while it lasted - after all, only witches refuse to pay! Unfortunately, the Inquisition took issue with her unsanctioned methods & then there were the accusations of extortion & questions to be answered... questions about how she came to wear the uniform of a sanctioned Witch Smeller Pursuivant, recently gone missing.
